productName: Sheet2Calendar — Idempotent Spreadsheet-to-Google Calendar Sync Engine

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of syncing spreadsheet project dates and schedules to Google Calendar getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With Sheet2Calendar, Event ID Writeback Prevents Duplicates Forever runs right where you already work. Supports Timed, All-Day & Multi-Day Events and One-Click Batch Sync or Automated Triggers—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle syncing spreadsheet project dates and schedules to Google Calendar, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch Sheet2Calendar in action: Stores the created Google Calendar Event ID directly in your sheet row so re-syncing updates changed titles, times, and locations instead of duplicating events. Map any spreadsheet columns to event title, start/end timestamps, description, location, and guest lists in seconds. Plus, publish a 100-row workshop schedule, content calendar, or shift roster in one click—or let scheduled background triggers keep it synced. Your executive schedules, launch dates, and team rosters sync directly between your Sheet and Calendar inside Google Workspace. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
